title: Toward Quantitative Domain-Motif Interactomes: State of the Art, Challenges, and Perspectives.
journal: Annual review of biomedical data science
one_liner_zh: 综述无序蛋白中基序与结构域互作(DMI)的分子特征、高通量实验与机器学习预测方法，聚焦定量互作图构建，虽为综述且机制深度有限，但对象与互作轴高度契合本课题。
abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) drive cellular function. Obtaining quantitative maps of protein interactomes is essential for linking genotype to phenotype and predicting cellular outcomes. A large fraction of PPIs are mediated by domain-motif interactions (DMIs), where motifs within intrinsically disordered regions bind to structured domains in partner proteins. These transient and low-affinity interactions play central roles in regulatory and cell signaling processes, and their disruption has been linked to disease. However, due to their transient and dynamic nature, systematic experimental characterization of DMIs has been challenging. Recent advances in high-throughput experimental technologies and machine learning are transforming our ability to map and predict DMIs on a proteome-wide scale. Here, we review the molecular characteristics of motifs, domains, and their interactions; discuss emerging experimental and computational approaches for their discovery; and outline current challenges and future directions toward quantitative DMI interactomes.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）驱动细胞功能。获取蛋白质相互作用组的定量图谱对于将基因型与表型联系起来并预测细胞结果至关重要。大部分PPIs由结构域-基序相互作用（DMIs）介导，其中内在无序区域内的基序与伴侣蛋白中的结构化结构域结合。这些瞬态且低亲和力的相互作用在调控和细胞信号传导过程中发挥核心作用，其破坏与疾病相关。然而，由于其瞬态和动态特性，对DMIs进行系统性实验表征一直颇具挑战。高通量实验技术和机器学习的最新进展正在变革我们在蛋白质组范围内绘制和预测DMIs的能力。在此，我们回顾了基序、结构域及其相互作用的分子特征；讨论了用于其发现的新兴实验和计算方法；并概述了实现定量DMI相互作用组所面临的当前挑战和未来方向。
